tools.name: echo
tools.title: Echo
tools.description: Echo the input text back to the caller. Use this to verify the Edooqoo MCP server is reachable.

tools.name: list_exercise_types
tools.title: List Edooqoo exercise types
tools.description: Return the catalog of ESL exercise types Edooqoo can generate, grouped by media requirement (no-media, picture-based, audio-based). Useful for lesson-plan assistants that need to know which exercise formats Edooqoo supports.

media.description: Filter by media requirement. Defaults to all.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.title: List Edooqoo ESL topics
tools.description: Return the Edooqoo ESL topic catalog (grammar, vocabulary, skills). Optionally filter by category or search substring. Useful for suggesting adult 1:1 lesson focus areas.

category.description: Filter by category (e.g. grammar, vocabulary, skills).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match on slug or label.

tools.name: list_students
tools.title: List my students
tools.description: List the calling teacher's students (id, name, CEFR level, main goal, last updated). Read-only. Requires a Personal MCP Token generated in Edooqoo → Settings → Agent integrations (MCP).

limit.description: Max number of students to return.

tools.name: get_student_summary
tools.title: Get student summary
tools.description: Return a full read-only summary for one student the calling teacher owns: profile fields, top skill metrics (by mastery), and the 5 most recent worksheets. Requires a Personal MCP Token.

student_id.description: UUID of the student. Get one from list_students.

tools.name: list_recent_worksheets
tools.title: List recent worksheets
tools.description: Return the calling teacher's most recent worksheets (optionally scoped to a student). Read-only.
